exposure: different treatment modalities (systemic methotrexate, uterine artery embolization, suction and evacuation, excision of scar pregnancy)
cohort: 23 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy at a tertiary care hospital in South India between 2017 and 2021, divided into two groups based on gestational age at diagnosis (below 8 weeks and above 8 weeks).
finding: Early diagnosis of cesarean scar pregnancy allows for successful management, with suction and evacuation being effective for early gestational ages and laparotomy with excision for later gestational ages and higher beta-HCG levels.
